# Space_Invaders — Implementation Plan

AAA retro-futurist reimagining of Taito's 1978 *Space Invaders*. Three.js + vanilla ES modules, served by Vite, 100 % procedural assets, hand-written physics, strict pooling, strict disposal.

## 0. Scope, states, and Definition of Done

```
BOOT ─► TITLE ─► WAVE_INTRO ─► PLAY ─┬─► PAUSED ─► PLAY
                     ▲               ├─► PLAYER_DEATH ─┬─► PLAY (lives > 0)
                     │               │                 └─► GAME_OVER (lives = 0)
                     │               ├─► GAME_OVER (invasion line breached)
                     └── WAVE_CLEAR ◄┘ (all 55 dead) ── wave 5 cleared ─► VICTORY
GAME_OVER / VICTORY ─► TITLE   (VICTORY also offers "continue — endless")
```

- **Win:** clear `WAVES_TO_WIN = 5` waves → VICTORY screen (score, accuracy, time, kills), option to continue endless.
- **Loss:** lives reach 0, or the lowest living invader's bottom edge ≤ `INVASION_Y`.
- **Done means:** `npm run dev` → `/Space_Invaders/` boots with zero console errors, keyboard + gamepad drive it, both terminal states are reachable. I verify by driving the page with Playwright (real key events at the browser input boundary), reading a DEV-only `window.__SI__` inspection hook for state/score, and checking `renderer.info.memory` returns to baseline after a full teardown/restart.

## 1. Core Gameplay — mathematical model

### 1.1 Coordinate system
Gameplay is strictly 2-D on the XY plane at z = 0; rendering is 3-D. +X right, +Y up, +Z toward camera.

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `HALF_WIDTH` | 16 | playfield x ∈ [−16, 16] |
| `PLAYER_Y` | 0 | cannon centre line |
| `INVASION_Y` | 1.4 | invader bottom ≤ this ⇒ game over |
| `BUNKER_Y` / `BUNKER_XS` | 4.0 / [−10.5, −3.5, 3.5, 10.5] | four bunkers |
| `FORMATION_TOP_Y` | 20.5 | top-row centre on wave 1 |
| `UFO_Y` | 23.5 | mystery-ship lane |
| `CULL_TOP_Y` / `CULL_BOTTOM_Y` | 26 / −2 | projectile despawn |
| `VOXEL` | 0.14 | invader bitmap pixel size |

Camera-fit (on resize, any aspect):
```
halfH = 13.5, halfW = 17, centreY = 12
dist  = max( halfH / tan(fov/2),  halfW / (tan(fov/2) · aspect) ) · 1.08
rig.basePosition = (0, centreY + 4.5, dist),  rig.baseTarget = (0, centreY, 0)
```
Gentle top-down tilt keeps 2-D readability while showing depth; rig adds parallax lean `offset.x = player.x · 0.06`.

### 1.2 Formation
55 invaders: 5 × 11. Row 0 = **squid** (30), rows 1–2 = **crab** (20), rows 3–4 = **octopus** (10).
`x = originX + c·COL_PITCH (2.2)`, `y = originY − r·ROW_PITCH (1.8)`. Wave `w` starts at `originY = FORMATION_TOP_Y − min(w−1, 4)·DROP_Y`.

**Tempo** (1978 machine moved one alien per frame ⇒ a full step took `alive` frames):
```
interval(alive, wave) = clamp(alive / 60, 0.045, 1.0) / (1 + 0.10·(wave − 1))
```
55 alive ⇒ 0.92 s/step; last alien ⇒ 0.045 s. The march bass note fires on each step, so the music accelerates organically.

**Stepping (fixed 120 Hz):**
```
timer += step
if timer ≥ interval:
    timer -= interval
    if pendingDrop:  originY -= DROP_Y (0.9);  dir = −dir;  pendingDrop = false;  emit 'invader:drop'
    else:            originX += dir·STEP_X (0.275)
                     b = aliveBounds()
                     if (dir>0 && b.maxX + HALF_W ≥ HALF_WIDTH − EDGE_MARGIN) ||
                        (dir<0 && b.minX − HALF_W ≤ −HALF_WIDTH + EDGE_MARGIN):  pendingDrop = true
    frame ^= 1;  hop ripple;  emit 'invader:step'
    if lowestAliveBottom() ≤ INVASION_Y:  emit 'invader:invaded'
```
Edge detection uses living invaders only ⇒ a thinned formation sweeps wider (classic). Attract mode: reverse without dropping.

**Shooting:**
```
maxShots(wave) = min(3 + floor((wave−1)/2), 5)
fireInterval   = rand(0.35, 1.10) · (0.55 + 0.45·alive/55) · max(1 − 0.06·(wave−1), 0.5)
col     = chance(0.35) ? aliveColumnNearest(player.x) : randomAliveColumn()
shooter = bottom-most living invader in col; kind ∈ {plunger, rolling, squiggly} (40/35/25)
```
Squiggly: `x = x0 + 0.25·sin(2π·9·age)`. Speed `9 + 0.6·(wave−1)`.

**Fly-in:** visual starts at `logical + (0, +14)`, easeOutCubic 0.7 s after delay `0.06·r + 0.03·c`; logic frozen ≈ 1.7 s, then landing shockwave.
**Hop (visual):** column delay `8 ms·c`; `offsetY = 0.12·sin(πt)`, `scaleY = 1 + 0.18·sin(πt)`, `scaleX = 1 − 0.10·sin(πt)`. Collision always uses logical positions.

### 1.3 Player cannon
```
target = axis('moveX') · 13;  vx = approach(vx, target, 140·step)
x = clamp(x + vx·step, −HALF_WIDTH + 1.1, HALF_WIDTH − 1.1);  bank = damp(bank, −vx/13 · 0.35, 12, dt)
```
One bullet in flight (classic) unless a power-up raises the cap; cooldown 0.16 s. Fire read via `input.takePress(FIRE)` (latched edge) so no press is lost on frames with zero fixed steps (144 Hz display vs 120 Hz sim). Hit: shield absorbs, else PLAYER_DEATH; respawn after 1.6 s with 2.5 s invulnerability blink.

### 1.4 Projectiles
Pooled: 6 player / 8 invader bullets. Every bullet stores `prevX/prevY` ⇒ **swept segment vs AABB** (slab test), no tunnelling at 30 wu/s. Player bullet vs invader bullet ⇒ both cancel (classic).

### 1.5 Bunkers
4 × (12 × 8 cells, `CELL = 0.32`), one `InstancedMesh` (384). Cell HP 2: scorch (instance colour) → removed (zero-scale matrix). Bullet: coarse AABB, then walk the segment through cells; `damage(cell, r=1)`: centre −2, 4-neighbours −1 with p 0.6. Invaders erase overlapping cells each step. Rebuilt every wave.

### 1.6 UFO
Every `rand(18, 28)` s while `alive ≥ 8`; 6.5 wu/s along `UFO_Y`; warble loop + scanning beam. Score easter egg preserved: `shots == 23 || (shots − 23) % 15 == 0` ⇒ 300, else weighted 50/100/150/300 (40/30/20/10 %).

### 1.7 Scoring, combo, lives, waves
Combo window 1.0 s; multiplier 1 (<3), 2 (3–5), 3 (6–8), 4 (≥9). Extra life at 1500 then every 10 000 (max 6). Wave bonus `100·wave + 5·survivingBunkerCells`; WAVE_CLEAR 2.4 s → WAVE_INTRO. Hi-score in `localStorage['si.hiscore']`.

### 1.8 Power-ups
7 % per kill (one on screen max), 3 wu/s descent. **SPREAD** (3 bolts ±12°, 10 s), **RAPID** (cap 2, cooldown 0.09, 10 s), **SHIELD** (absorb one hit).

### 1.9 Loop
Real dt clamped 0.1 s → `HitStop.timeScale` → accumulator → ≤ 8 × `fixedUpdate(1/120)` → `update(dt, realDt)` → VFX → render. Sim/particles/trails/rings use scaled dt (freeze during hit-stop); shake & floating text use real dt.

## 2. Modern Enhancements (19)
1. **Instanced voxel invaders** — bitmaps → merged `BoxGeometry` per type × frame → 6 `InstancedMesh`es; 55 aliens = 3 draw calls.
2. **Hop ripple** — per-column delayed squash-stretch on every step.
3. **2-HP destructible voxel bunkers** — single `InstancedMesh`, scorch colour, debris, eaten by invaders.
4. **Tempo-locked audio** — four-note descending march (E2 D#2 D2 C#2) fires per step; `MusicSequencer` pads rise with pressure.
5. **Mystery ship with scan beam** — `LatheGeometry` saucer, rotating emissive rim, cone beam, detuned-triangle warble.
6. **Player ship feel** — banking, thruster particle stream, pooled intensity-toggled muzzle `PointLight` (no runtime light add/remove ⇒ no recompiles), recoil.
7. **Bullet trails** — ribbons for player bolts; three distinct invader bullet geometries.
8. **Power-ups** — Spread / Rapid / Shield, pooled, HUD timers.
9. **Combo multiplier** — HUD chip with draining bar, colour-ramped `×N` text.
10. **Invasion pressure** — `pressure = clamp((BUNKER_Y + 2 − lowestY)/8, 0, 1)` drives red pulse light, vignette tint, music, rumble.
11. **Hit-stop hierarchy** (§4).
12. **Trauma camera** + trauma-driven chromatic aberration.
13. **Post stack** — HDR half-float MSAA target → UnrealBloom → RetroPass → OutputPass.
14. **Synthwave environment** — scrolling emissive grid, striped sun disc, two-layer instanced starfield, fBm planet.
15. **Procedural SFX** — laser, invader death, player explosion, bunker chip, power-up arp, UI, 1UP, stingers.
16. **Glass HUD** — score/hi/wave/lives/combo/power-up chips; title, pause, game-over, victory with keyboard + gamepad nav.
17. **Wave intro choreography** — text burst, staggered fly-in, landing shockwave.
18. **Faithful UFO scoring easter egg** + accuracy stat.
19. **Attract mode** — formation marches behind the title; audio unlocks on first input.

## 3. Graphics pipeline

**Renderer:** `antialias:false`, DPR ≤ 2, `SRGBColorSpace`, ACES exposure 1.0, clear `#05060f`. Composer target `WebGLRenderTarget{ HalfFloatType, samples: 4 }`.

**Post stack:**
```
RenderPass → UnrealBloomPass(strength 0.75, radius 0.40, threshold 0.85)
→ ShaderPass(RetroShader: uAberration 0.0012 + 0.006·trauma, uVignette 0.38, uVignetteColor,
             uScanlines 0.05, uGrain 0.035, uFlash decays 4/s, uTime, uResolution)
→ OutputPass (tone-map + sRGB)
```
Bloom rule: emitters `emissiveIntensity ∈ [1.6, 3.0]` with saturated colours (never white); lit hull surfaces stay < 0.85.

RetroShader:
```
d = uv − 0.5;  ca = uAberration·(1 + 2·dot(d,d))
col = vec3(tex(uv + d·ca).r, tex(uv).g, tex(uv − d·ca).b)
scan = 1 − uScanlines·(0.5 + 0.5·sin(uv.y·uResolution.y·1.5))
vig  = 1 − uVignette·smoothstep(0.35, 1.2, length(d)·1.4)
col  = mix(col·scan, uVignetteColor, 1 − vig) + grain;  col = mix(col, uFlash.rgb, uFlash.a)
```

**Lighting (fixed set):** hemisphere `#1b2140/#0a0614` 0.55 · key `#cfe8ff` 0.9 @ (6,18,12) · rim `#ff2bd6` 0.45 @ (−8,6,−10) · player cyan point 1.2 · invasion red point 0..6 · 3 pooled muzzle points.

**Procedural math:** bitmap→geometry (`BoxGeometry(VOXEL, VOXEL, 1.4·VOXEL)` at `((i−w/2+0.5)·VOXEL, (h/2−j−0.5)·VOXEL, 0)`, merged); cannon = displaced box chassis + cylinder turret + barrel + separate neon engine block, canvas plating map + inverted-luminance roughness map; saucer lathe profile `[(0,−.25),(.9,−.2),(1.6,0),(1.2,.25),(.6,.45),(0,.5)]`; grid floor 1024² canvas, 32 cells, blurred glow + core lines, repeat (16,16), scroll 0.12/s, used as `map` + `emissiveMap`; sun 512² radial amber→magenta with 9 growing stripes on `CircleGeometry(14)` @ (0,14,−60); planet 512² fBm (5 oct) colour ramp + city-light emissive mask > 0.62, `SphereGeometry(9)` @ (−28,20,−70); starfield 500 + 250 instanced icosahedra in `z ∈ [−80,−30]`, drifting/wrapping.

## 4. VFX priority logic

**Shake:** `intensity = trauma²`; offsets = `0.55·intensity·noise2D(t·18, ·)`, roll `2.2°·intensity·noise`; decay 1.4/s; `addImpulse(v, k)` ⇒ `trauma += clamp(|v|·k, 0, 1)`.
**Hit-stop:** `request(duration, scale, priority)` — ignored if an equal/higher-priority stop has more time left; higher priority overrides; eases back to 1 over the final 30 %.
**Particles:** one `InstancedMesh` (icosahedron, `MeshStandardMaterial` + `onBeforeCompile` multiplying `totalEmissiveRadiance` by instance colour). 500 hard cap. `v += g·dt; v *= 1 − drag·dt; size → s0·endScale; colour = c0·(1−t)^1.5`. **Eviction:** when full, evict the oldest live particle with priority ≤ incoming, else drop.

| Event | Particles (n, prio) | Ring | Trauma | Hit-stop | Text |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| player fires | 3, 0 | — | 0.03 | — | — |
| invader killed | 26, 1 | 0.3→1.6 | 0.12 | 40 ms @0.15 p1 | `+pts ×N` |
| bunker chip | 6, 0 | — | 0.05 | — | — |
| bullets cancel | 8, 0 | small | 0.04 | — | — |
| formation drop | — | — | 0.08 | — | — |
| UFO killed | 70, 2 | 0.5→4 | 0.35 | 120 ms @0.05 p2 | `+pts` lg |
| shield absorbs | 30, 2 | 1→2.5 | 0.25 | 60 ms @0.2 p1 | `SHIELD` |
| player death | 140, 3 | 0.5→6 | 0.70 | 250 ms @0.02 p3 | flash |
| wave clear | 60, 2 | 2→14 | 0.20 | 200 ms @0.1 p2 | `WAVE CLEARED` |
| power-up | 24, 1 | 0.4→2 | 0.10 | 50 ms @0.3 p1 | name |
| extra life | 40, 1 | — | 0.10 | — | `1UP` |
